key.name: media-on-top
key.summary: Keep the music card above app windows
key.description: When off, the card sits on the desktop and app windows cover it.

key.name: panel-icon-visible
key.summary: Show the music icon in the top bar
key.description: Clicking it brings the music card above the app windows until it is clicked again or a window gets the focus.

key.name: media-locked
key.summary: Stop the music card from being dragged

key.name: media-positions
key.summary: Top-left corner of the music card, per set of monitors
key.description: Maps the names of the plugged-in monitors to the monitor holding the card and the card's offset from that monitor's top-left corner, in pixels. With no entry the card goes near the top-right corner of the primary monitor.

key.name: media-position
key.summary: Top-left corner of the music card (old)
key.description: In screen pixels; moved into media-positions on the next start and reset to (-1, -1).

key.name: media-background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the music card background, in percent
key.description: 0 leaves only the art, text, bars and buttons on the wallpaper.
